media.guidelines: Use abstract_background as a low-opacity (10-15%) overlay with multiply/screen blend modes to give the dashboard a raw, hacker-terminal feel. Do not use generic placeholders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a live feed dashboard tracking Bankr Bot claim events on Base.
Use Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) with a deep void black background and high-contrast neon accents (Green, Cyan, Pink). Avoid teal #1B93A4 or purple #7351B7.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid: dense, modular data panels.
Avoid border-radius (use rounded-none) to emphasize the retro-futurism/terminal look.
Import fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: 'Azeret Mono' and 'IBM Plex Mono'.
Use Azeret Mono for headings and IBM Plex Mono for body text.
Ensure all text has adequate contrast. Use text shadows for glows.

Component logic: Use custom HTML/Tailwind for structural bento layouts, but wrap Shadcn components for complex interactions if needed (e.g., Dialogs). Strip Shadcn's default borders/radius and apply the terminal style.
Top KPI strip: Total Claims, Total ETH, Unique Claimers, 24h Claims.
Main sections: Live Feed (table or scrolling list), Top Claimers (leaderboard), Token Detail Chart (Recharts).
Include an 'Add Token' input field with terminal-style styling.
For the live feed, mock the data using realistic Twitter handles, token tickers, and ETH amounts. Ensure each event card has the Twitter avatar and Basescan tx link.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key informational elements.
